'''Taren Vor''' was a [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he was on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] and was ambushed and [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] forces.<ref name="TOR" />
